$comment: boxPx, baselinePx, deltaE2000, ssimNonText and ssimElement are calibrated in M0 (docs/findings/m0.md §11). The text ink keys come from the fidelity suite's measurement of every kit text style, light on dark and dark on light, at 2560, 1920 and 1280, with the designs rendering -webkit-font-smoothing: antialiased (docs/findings/text-ink.md): ink colour ΔE2000 at most 1.26 from 9 device px up, 2.12 at 8 px, 8.23 at 6 px; Unity's ink amount 0.92-1.08 of the design's, within -5 % … +11.7 % of the capture's median per polarity. Limits = measured plus a margin: textInkDeltaE from textInkFullPx device px, below it the first [px, limit] pair of textInkDeltaESmall the text reaches; a line's ink amount between textInkRatio x (1 - textInkCoverage) and 1 + textInkCoverage, and within textInkMedianTolerance of the median of the capture's text of the same polarity when there are 3 or more such lines. ssimElementSmall and ssimPicture (docs/findings/ssim-small-elements.md): element SSIM of elements whose box, colour, ring, ink and shadow checks all pass, measured over every capture of the suite: under 32768 device px² the lowest 0.9851 (bordered fields and buttons with rounded corners, radios, icons), scaled raster pictures 0.9867; never below 0.97. textInkDeltaELater, textInkLaterBelowPx, textInkCoverageLater (docs/findings/text-baselines.md): lines after the first of text under 12 device px, with baselines where Chromium lays them out, measured ink colour ΔE2000 up to 4.19 at 9 px and 5.66 at 8 px (1.38 at 12 px), ink amount 0.91-1.11. textInkSmallPx, textInkDeltaEFirstSmall, textInkBandSmall (docs/findings/text-ink.md section 7): text of at most 12 device px, over the whole suite: ink colour ΔE2000 at most 3.83 (2.37 at 12 px, 3.49 at 9 px, 3.83 at 8 px; 6 px stays under its limit of 10), ink amount 0.84-1.17 of the design's (the upper end is text shadow ink); a text shadow's ink also moves a line from the median of its capture's text by up to 19 %; limits 4.5, 0.80-1.25 and ±25 % of the median. textInkShadowHigh (docs/findings/text-ink.md section 8): text with a blurred text-shadow, whose glow inside the line counts as ink: Unity's ink amount up to 1.111 of the design's (a 12 px glow at all three viewports; every other blurred shadow 0.93-1.04); limit 1.15, colour check unchanged. ssimRotated (docs/findings/animation.md, Rotated animation samples): element SSIM of every element an animation sample shows rotated off the axes (the design's rotation on the screen not a multiple of 90°) whose other checks pass, over the whole suite: 297 element samples of 9 elements, lowest 0.9779 (the keyframes fixture's wobble circle at -10° at 1280), every other element 0.9916 or more; Chromium draws an element under a running transform animation from its composited layer, resampled, UI Toolkit the rotated mesh with its own edge. Limit 0.975 (lowest minus 0.003), static captures keep their limits. deltaE2000Ring (docs/findings/viewport-classes.md, Ring colour): the middle of each border side of 2 device px or more of a round element without text (a radio, an avatar ring), its ring's centre pixel, in every static capture at every viewport: over the suite’s 69 such elements, 12168 element samples of static captures, the highest is 2.67 (a hovered 2 px radio ring at 1280x720; the unchecked radio 1.10), limit highest plus 0.4; an element an animation sample moves is not judged there (Chromium resamples the moving layer, up to 14 at a translated border); since ruling R132 only an animation of geometry (transform and its parts, position, size, box-model lengths) moves an element, and every other element of a sample is judged as in a static capture. ssimRoundEdge (docs/findings/viewport-classes.md, Edge bands; ruling R119): anti-aliasing differences, at every viewport: a round element without text (a radio, an avatar ring) whose difference lies in the edge band of its round shapes (its SSIM with every pixel within 1 device px of a corner's outer curve or its border's inner curve masked meets ssimElement, its ring's colour within deltaE2000Ring and its other checks pass), and in an animation sample an element moved to a fractional device offset whose difference lies in that band and the band of its moved straight edges (pixels within 1 device px of the edge in the design and in Unity; Chromium draws the moving layer resampled), may meet ssimRoundEdge. Measured at exact viewports: 16 radio captures at 1280x720 (0.98088) and 1 transition sample (0.98296), every band-masked SSIM 0.99 or more; 0.974 (the scaled class's measured floor) is kept as the ruling allows. deltaE2000RoundEdge is off (deltaE2000) here, as are the scaled class's own ssimFractionalEdge, ssimVectorEdge (ssimElement) and deltaE2000FractionalEdge (deltaE2000); the measured values are in the scaled block. Edge-band evidence (rulings R129, R130; docs/findings/viewport-classes.md, Edge-band evidence): every edge-band relaxation (ssimRoundEdge, ssimFractionalEdge, ssimVectorEdge and the corner limits) needs, outside its band, every 8 px SSIM block of the region at ssimElement or more and every 3x3 window within deltaE2000 of Unity's closest within 1 px (not the region's mean), and for every border its band masks its drawn width within 0.5 device px of the design's and, unless an animation sample moves it (ruling R132), the centre pixel of each side of 2 device px or more within deltaE2000Ring (this file's; the scaled block cannot change it; a thinner side gives no evidence). The ring of a round element without text is held to the same width unless an animation sample moves it (ruling R127); the width check decides reliably from 0.75 device px, so a ring 0.5 device px thinner (1 CSS px at 1280x720) can pass (ruling R135). ssimResampledPicture and deltaE2000ResampledPicture are off here (ssimElement, deltaE2000); the scaled block holds the measured values (ruling R125). textInkDirection (docs/findings/viewport-classes.md, Hairline lines; ruling R138): a text line the design draws with fewer than 3 fully covered pixels (at least 0.85 of the declared colour's luma distance from the background), in the declared colour's direction and with its most covered pixel at half of it or more (an em dash or a "1" of one stroke between two device pixels at 10 and 10.67 device px), is judged by the angle between the design's and Unity's ink directions from the background in sRGB instead of its ink colour and amount, which measure coverage there; measured over the suite's 180 such lines the highest is 0.26 degrees, limit highest plus 0.4. A lightness-only error of such a line is not caught.

scaled.$comment: Measured scaled-class limits (docs/findings/viewport-classes.md, Round edges at scaled viewports), only for the anti-aliasing ramp of round shapes, which UI Toolkit draws at the layout scale's pixel under the root scale. ssimRoundEdge: an element whose SSIM with the edge band of its round shapes masked meets ssimElement and whose other checks pass; lowest measured 0.9774 (143 keyframes animation samples at 1600x900 and 1366x768), limit lowest minus 0.003. deltaE2000RoundEdge: a corner sample whose window reaches that band and whose window pixels outside it meet deltaE2000; highest measured 5.10 (a ghost button's focus ring corner at 1366x768; 21 corner samples), limit highest plus 0.4. textInkSmallPx (docs/findings/viewport-classes.md, Text ink at fractional sizes): the root scale draws the kit's text at fractional sizes (12.5 px at 1600x900, 12.8 at 1366x768), whose ink colour scatters up to 4.29 like small text, where whole 13 and 14 px stay within 2 (1.98, 1.94): text of at most 12.99 device px takes the small-text ink limits here. Ruling R121 (docs/findings/viewport-classes.md, Scaled-class residuals), each only at scaled viewports and only with the evidence that its difference lies in a band of at most 1 device px of the element's edges: ssimFractionalEdge, an element whose SSIM with its straight edges between two device pixels masked as well (the box's edges and its border's inner edges, own and descendants', pixels within 1 device px of the edge in the design and in Unity) meets ssimElement and whose other checks pass; lowest measured 0.9735 (a four-colour 4.27 device px border at 1366x768; a focused button 0.9748 at 1600x900), limit lowest minus 0.003. ssimVectorEdge, a vector picture whose SSIM with its drawn edges masked (pixels within 1 device px of a colour change in the design, at least half its region left compared) meets ssimElement; lowest measured 0.97875 (a 30 device px star at 1366x768, 0.98096 at 1600x900), limit lowest minus 0.003. deltaE2000FractionalEdge, a corner sample whose window reaches those straight edges and whose window pixels outside them and the round-edge band (at least 3) meet deltaE2000; highest measured 4.90 (a focus ring at 1366x768; 1.42 at 1600x900), limit highest plus 0.4. Ruling R125 (Resampled pictures): ssimResampledPicture, an element that draws a raster picture at another size than its own (its other checks passing); lowest measured 0.95284 (background-images at 1600x900; 0.97866 at 1366x768), limit that rounded down to 0.01, its own floor below the general 0.97; deltaE2000ResampledPicture, such a picture's colour samples, highest measured 5.49 (1366x768), limit highest plus 0.4; both pictures pass at every exact viewport of the same run. Ruling R126 (Small text at scaled viewports): textInkDeltaEFirstSmall, the ink colour limit of text of at most textInkSmallPx device px; highest measured 5.49 over the suite's 10746 element samples of such text (stacked-text, 10.67 px at 1366x768; every such text passes at every exact viewport), limit highest plus 0.4, never above 6.5.
